name: Gasthof Einhorn Schaller
kurzbeschreibung:
**The Einhorn Schaller Inn in Schwaz**

Welcome to **Gasthof Einhorn Schaller**, a cozy and traditional guesthouse nestled in the heart of **Schwaz**, a charming town in **Tirol**. Here, you’ll experience authentic Tyrolean hospitality in a warm, rustic setting.

Our family-run inn offers comfortable rooms with a homely touch, where you can relax after exploring the stunning surroundings. Whether you’re hiking through the **Zillertal Alps**, visiting the historic **Schwaz Silver Mines**, or strolling through the picturesque old town, our location is the perfect base for your adventures.

Indulge in hearty Tyrolean cuisine at our restaurant. Savor classics like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Tiroler Gröstl**, or a perfectly grilled **Schweinsbraten** with **Krautsalat**—all made with fresh, local ingredients. Pair your meal with a glass of our fine selection of regional wines or a frothy **Tiroler Bier**.

After a day of exploration, unwind in our cozy lounge with a traditional **Schnaps** or a steaming cup of **Tiroler Bergkäse** soup. We also offer a selection of homemade desserts, including our famous **Apfelstrudel** and **Kaiserschmarrn** with vanilla sauce.

For families, we provide a welcoming atmosphere with a play area and family-friendly rooms. Children will love the chance to meet our friendly horses and enjoy a ride through the countryside.

Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, **Gasthof Einhorn Schaller** is the ideal retreat for nature lovers, culture seekers, and those looking to taste the true flavors of **Tirol**. We look forward to welcoming you!
